attributes.additional_details: The UK’s travel can be slow all the time so they need to order a good amount of Bullet trains to make travel, Quicker, Smoother and Cheaper
attributes.background: To make travel quicker order 100 bullet trains and have them run across the Uk making travel quicker and smoother

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do. High speed rail requires completely new infrastructure (including tracks) to run. We do not know where exactly you want new high speed rail infrastructure to be constructed, or what routes you wish to see high speed rail on.

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do.
